node.name: Sausage and Vegetable Skillet
node.description: This super fast and easy Sausage and Vegetable Skillet is the ultimate busy-day meal and is perfect for meal prep!
recipeIngredient: ½ tsp seasoning salt or seasoning blend (or to taste) ($0.05)

recipeInstructions.text: Add the cooking oil and sausage to a skillet. Cook the sausage over medium heat until brown and crispy.
recipeInstructions.name: Add the cooking oil and sausage to a skillet. Cook the sausage over medium heat until brown and crispy.

recipeInstructions.text: Add the cauliflower, peppers and onions, and kale to the skillet with the sausage. Continue to stir and cook until the vegetables are heated through.
recipeInstructions.name: Add the cauliflower, peppers and onions, and kale to the skillet with the sausage. Continue to stir and cook until the vegetables are heated through.

recipeInstructions.text: Add a liberal amount (or to taste) of your favorite seasoning salt or seasoning blend and stir to combine. Serve hot.
